pair.title: Connect your SMARWI
pair.subtitle: Fill in the local IP address, the vektiva.online Device ID, or both.
pair.hint: You can find it in the SMARWI web interface or in your router. A fixed (reserved) address is strongly recommended.
pair.device_id_hint: Needed only for control over the internet, e.g. when the SMARWI is on a different network than Homey. Find it in your vektiva.online device list.
pair.no_address: Enter an IP address or a Device ID.
pair.no_credentials: Set your Remote ID and API key in the app settings first (Settings → Apps → Vektiva SMARWI).

settings.title: vektiva.online account
settings.intro: These credentials are only needed for control over the internet. Devices reachable on your local network work without them.
settings.where: Find both on vektiva.online under the API menu. Generating a new API key invalidates the old one.
settings.test_device_id_hint: Any of your SMARWI Device IDs — the test only sends an unknown command, so no window moves.
settings.test_address_hint: Checks that Homey itself can reach the SMARWI. Reads the status only.
settings.web_intro: Opens the device's own settings (calibration, finetune, WiFi) in a new tab. It cannot be shown inside Homey — this page is HTTPS and the SMARWI only speaks HTTP. You must be on the same network.
settings.finetune_intro: The same nine values as the Finetune tab of the SMARWI web interface. Apply writes them to the running device only (gone after a reboot) — Save stores them permanently.
settings.finetune_applied: Applied — until the next reboot of the SMARWI.
settings.finetune_reset_confirm: Really reset the Finetune values to factory defaults?

errors.unreachable: SMARWI is not reachable on the network.
errors.no_transport: No connection configured — set an IP address, or a Device ID plus your vektiva.online credentials.
errors.finetune_needs_local: Finetune settings can only be written over the local network — set the IP address of the SMARWI first.

warnings.using_cloud: Not reachable locally — commands go through vektiva.online and the reported state may be out of date.
warnings.using_local: vektiva.online is not responding — commands are going over the local network instead.
warnings.using_mqtt: Not reachable locally - commands and status are going through MQTT.

widget.pending: Waiting for the SMARWI to get ready…
widget.banner_released: Ridge released — the window can be moved by hand
